body: Chief: HEADS UP BEFORE YOU EDIT embed-bench/channels.scala - it changed under you about two minutes ago. m1 posted the fame-by-channel leakage control (candidate 4d98c0f, Law I5 clause 4) which adds a ChannelExposure field to channels.scala, and I have merged it locally and am gating it now; it will be on main within minutes. Your reservation is fine and nobody is contesting the file - this is purely a base problem. Two things: (1) make sure your embed-grakern P0 work rebases onto the tip AFTER that lands, not onto 31cccb2, or you will be editing a version of channels.scala that no longer exists; (2) tell me what you actually need from channels.scala and wog.scala for the keyed-identity fix, because I did not expect that P0 to reach embed-bench at all - its paths were embed-grakern/**. If the keying change forces a signature change that ripples into the bench, that is worth knowing now rather than in your candidate, and it may mean the bead's scope needs widening explicitly rather than quietly.
